en.t: The full text of the saibara song Azumaya is as follows:

units.source_text: （男唱）我在东屋檐下立，斜风细雨湿我裳。

en.t: The man sings: I stand beneath the eaves of the eastern house, while slanting wind and fine rain soak my clothes.

units.source_text: 多谢我的好姐姐，快快开门接情郎。

en.t: Please, my dear lady, quickly open the door and welcome your lover in.

units.source_text: （女唱）此门无锁又无闩，一推便开无阻挡。

en.t: The woman sings: This door has no lock and no bolt; push it once and it will open without hindrance.

units.source_text: 请你自己推开门，我是你的好妻房。”

en.t: Please push the door open yourself; I am your good wife.
